description: List every app (project) in your Crossdeck portfolio that this connector can read — the same set your Pulse dashboard shows. Returns an array of { id, name } per app. Call this FIRST when a workspace key (cd_wk_) is connected, then pass an id to other tools or set a default with use_project. With a single-app key it returns just that one app. Read-only; takes no arguments.
name: list_projects
title: List your apps
